key_themes: Trump White House endorsement sparks retail investor rally in Dell
Semiconductor equipment names surge on major analyst upgrades (ASML, LRCX)
Pharma M&A heats up as Vertex acquires Crinetics for $10B at 102% premium
AI chip sector extends losses (MU, INTC, AMD) despite broader market recovery
Auto parts sector shaken by O'Reilly $10B bid for Genuine Parts auto unit

stocks.reason: Stock surged 7-8% after President Trump rang the opening bell from the Oval Office and publicly urged Americans to buy Dell computers, his second such endorsement in 2026. Trump disclosed owning $1M-$5M in Dell shares.

Stock rose ~4% after Broadcom extended its chip supply partnership with Apple through 2031, expanding from wireless/connectivity into custom AI-capable ASICs — locking in Apple (~20% of revenue) as a multi-year design win.

Stock roughly doubled after Vertex Pharmaceuticals announced a definitive agreement to acquire Crinetics for $85/share in cash ($10B total equity value), a 102% premium, to expand into endocrinology/acromegaly.

Announced $10B all-cash acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals to enter endocrinology, financed via cash on hand and $4.5B bridge financing from BofA and Morgan Stanley. Deal expected to close Q3 2026.
Stock up 4%+ after Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $404 from $331 (Overweight maintained), citing AI-driven expansion in wafer fab equipment demand. Also featured in CNBC premarket movers.

Shares surged 4%+ after Bernstein hiked its price target by more than 30% to $2,300, with analysts citing unprecedented AI-driven expansion in both logic and DRAM capacity as justification for a significantly higher valuation.
Shares rose 1%+ after Bank of America upgraded T-Mobile to Buy from Neutral with a $220 price target, citing improved competitive positioning and subscriber growth outlook.
Stock fell 5.5% as AI semiconductor names extended a two-day losing streak, pressured by ongoing concerns about memory cost trajectory and a broader de-rating of AI-exposed chip valuations.
Stock declined 5.3% in the AI chip sector sell-off despite an initial premarket bounce of 2.5%. Featured in CNBC premarket movers (LRCX, INTC, DDOG article) as a key watch for session direction.
Shares fell 4.3% as the AI semiconductor sell-off continued for a second consecutive session, with multiple sell-side notes flagging valuation concerns across the sector.

Stock dropped ~7% to its lowest level since January 2025 after Bloomberg reported O'Reilly is pursuing a ~$10B cash bid for Genuine Parts' auto parts division, raising investor concerns about deal size, leverage, and integration risk.
Shares surged ~13% on reports that O'Reilly Automotive made a ~$10B cash offer for Genuine Parts' auto parts business, representing a meaningful premium for the division.
HSBC upgraded Gilead to Buy from Hold and raised its price target to $155 from $133, cited as one of the top Wall Street analyst calls on Monday per Yahoo Finance and CNBC.

Bernstein downgraded Datadog to Market Perform from Outperform (despite raising the price target to $226 from $180), weighing on the stock. Also featured in CNBC premarket movers list alongside LRCX and INTC.
